diagnosis.cause: The uploaded search checked the wall clock only before entering a tree iteration and every 32 completed iterations. Each node expansion then called complete-turn generation without a deadline. A generation begun just before expiry could run its full 256-action non-root search and cross the hard turn limit. The post-loop root fallback also called the same unbounded generator after expiry. The 155 ms internal later budget left insufficient margin below CodinGame's 200 ms hard limit on a slower shared runner.
diagnosis.exact_source_local_observation: All three exact pre-timeout states overran the requested 155 ms deadline even on the local runner. The three 10-run maxima were 159.912, 161.361, and 162.114 ms. CodinGame recorded focus timeouts for the same states.
diagnosis.scope: Operational diagnosis only; no state, action, result, or outcome from this rejected window is eligible for training.

fix.complete_turn_generation: Timed generation now checks the deadline throughout partial expansion, stops before final sorting when reserve is exhausted, and returns a deterministic legal complete-turn emergency action if interrupted before any boundary is complete.
